notes: Litepanels Gemini 2x1 Hard is an RGBWW LED studio light panel (500W nominal draw, mains PowerCON True1 100-240VAC/50-60Hz, DC battery input 26-33VDC per Markertek retailer spec; another secondary source cites 28-33VDC — could not resolve the discrepancy against the primary manufacturer manual, which is Cloudflare-blocked (litepanels.com and B&H both returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch). Port list (PowerCON in/out, 3-pin XLR DC in, 5-pin XLR DMX in/out, RJ45 DMX in/out, USB-A) is corroborated across Markertek and independent aggregated search results referencing the official Litepanels connector-panel diagram, but was not verified against the manufacturer PDF directly. No standard connector id exists for "3-pin XLR DC power" (only xlr4-dc/euroblock-dc are power-specific XLR ids) so xlr3 was used as the closest match. Also present but omitted here because no matching connector id exists in the allowed list: a proprietary Bluetooth/wireless-DMX expansion dongle port and a future-use WiFi antenna connector. No connectors on this device carry a bandwidth grade (DMX and USB firmware port do not have stated speed/version ratings), so grade is omitted on all ports. Not rack-mountable (yoke-mounted studio fixture), so rackUnits is omitted. Category/type enums provided don't include a "lighting fixture" option, so both were set to "other"/"Other" as the closest available choice.
